basis: Original PNG opened separately before any figure context, edition prose, author draft or reviewer material.

subfigures.description: One composite apparatus drawing; no separately lettered panels.

components.description: Large near-circular outlined disk occupying the lower majority of the image.
Narrow nearly vertical outlined stem attached to the disk at its bottom and extending downward.

Eight filled inward-pointing triangular perimeter marks at approximately top, upper right, right, lower right, bottom, lower left, left and upper left. Clock-face positions describe appearance, not given angles.
Numerous short dark marks between the eight triangles, uneven in the scan; no readable numeric scale.

A dense series of predominantly horizontal thin dark lines fills most of the disk interior; lengths vary with the circular boundary and central structure. Multiple strokes are broken, merged or doubled in the scan.

A narrow light stripe runs approximately vertically through the interior, from below the top triangle through the central structure toward the lower interior; horizontal dark lines terminate or break at this stripe.
Central horizontally elongated pale, dark-outlined structure with two tapered/rounded halves, dark oblique hatching, and a break along the light vertical stripe.
Small dark loop or rounded end immediately left of the central pale structure.
Small dark loop or rounded end immediately right of the central pale structure.
Small outlined cap/base immediately above the disk, with a curved/sloping top and dark round marks along its lower face.
Narrow upright neck joining the cap/base to an upper assembly.
Small vertically elongated enclosed region with repeated dark transverse/zigzag-like marks.
Irregular dark block/clamp with a short leftward projection above the marked enclosed region.

relationships.fact: Triangles, short marks, horizontal lines, clear stripe and central elongated structure share the same circular frame.
The central elongated structure lies left-to-right; its rounded ends lie on opposite sides of the central clear stripe.
The clear stripe crosses the predominantly horizontal line field approximately at a right angle; no exact numerical angle is printed.
Upper assembly is nearly upright above the disk's top and broadly aligned with the vertical clear stripe and lower stem.
The lower stem touches the circular border at its bottom.

explicitArrowheads: Eight inward-pointing triangular marks are visible; whether these are arrows or dial marks is not assigned from pixels alone.
unresolvedPixelFacts: Exact number and calibration meaning of the small perimeter marks.
Exact number of dense horizontal strokes; no regular numeric lattice can be established from this scan.
Scientific identity and role of the central, upper and disk structures.
Meaning of the light stripe and any actual scientific relation it represents.
